narrative.overview: The board is a timetable: fixed columns, ruled rows, one type size. It shows who works on what and for how long, and puts what waits for the user first. It refuses the card-grid dashboard on a grey ground. The source of truth is `frontend/src/index.css`; shared controls live in `frontend/src/components/ui.tsx`.
keyCharacteristics: Two named themes, `carbon` (dark) and `stone` (light), each one block of tokens.
One type size. Rank comes from weight, case, reversal and rule.
Hairline rules instead of cards. Flat surfaces, 2px corners.
Vermilion means "this waits for you". Green only confirms.

rules.name: The Semantic Only Rule
rules.body: Components use the semantic colours above, never a Tailwind palette colour (`zinc-500`, `red-600`) and never a hex value.

rules.name: The For You Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is reserved for what waits for the user or needs them: an open decision, a to-do, an error, a limit reached. Nothing else uses it.

rules.name: The Confirm Rule
rules.body: Green only confirms that something is done or passed. It never decorates and never marks an action.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: There is one type size. Do not add `text-sm`, `text-lg` or pixel sizes. Rank by weight, case, reversal and rule. Priority follows the same rule: low is muted, high is 600, urgent is caps at 800.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest has no shadow. If it does not float above the page, it gets a rule, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Fixed Cell Rule
rules.body: State is a 9px mark in a fixed first cell of the row (`.mk`): filled circle = working, hollow circle = queued or in the background, vermilion diamond = waits for you, green check = done, empty = idle. State is never told by row colour alone or by a badge.

dos: Do build lists as ruled rows: `border-b border-line`, hover `bg-sunk`.
Do reuse `ui.tsx`, `.caps`, `.plate` and `.mk*` before writing new classes.

Do add a theme like this: copy a token block in `index.css` and name it `[data-theme="<id>"]`, list it in `THEMES` in `lib/theme.ts` with its `dark` flag and browser bar colour, and add the id to the pre-paint script in `frontend/index.html`. The `dark:` variant in `index.css` only matches `carbon`; extend it for another dark theme.
donts: Don't use palette colours or hex values in components.
Don't use vermilion for emphasis, branding or a primary action.
Don't use green for anything that is not a confirmation.
Don't change the type size to show rank.
Don't wrap content in cards with borders, radius and shadow.
Don't add a shadow to anything that is not an overlay, or a radius other than 2px.
